title: Fixture folder: DAW-saved reference sidecars, broken variants, audio digests
description:
## Intent
Real-format fixtures, checked into git, with no audio.

## Scope
- `crates/apricity-daw/tests/fixtures/`: the owner's DAW-saved `.asd`/`.alc` files from M0, plus hand-made broken variants (truncated, out-of-order markers, unknown version, not gzip) each produced by a documented one-line command.
- `fixtures/README.md`: DAW version; for each file, how it was made and the markers the DAW showed (the expectations the specs read).
- `fixtures/audio.sha256`: sha256 of each WAV from `scripts/daw-fixture-audio.py`; a test helper `fixture_audio(dir)` generates them into a temp dir and checks the digests (fails loudly if the generator drifted).
- `.gitignore` guard test: `git ls-files crates/apricity-daw/tests/fixtures | grep -E '\\.(wav|mp3|aif)$'` is empty (in the runner).
- `fixtures/manifests/`: analysis manifests for each WAV (`*.wav.apricity.json`), produced once with `apricity_analyze.cli` and trimmed, validated against `schema/sample-manifest.schema.json`.

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw fixtures` and `python3 scripts/daw-fixture-audio.py --out $(mktemp -d) --check`.

Commit: `chore(<this id>): real-format DAW sidecar fixtures`.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
